result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text ('25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' rendered on top of each other), making both unreadable. Other elements (carousel clipping at the right edge, card cut off at the bottom) are expected behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' title, the delivery-time text ('25–30 min') and the delivery-fee text ('€0 delivery') overlap each other, producing garbled, unreadable text ('25–3€0 delivery' style collision).
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the restaurant meta row so each label occupies its own space (e.g., use a horizontal flex row with gap/separators instead of absolutely positioned or negatively margined elements), ensuring '25–30 min', '€0 delivery', and 'Ramen' do not overlap.
